definition: to keep someone or something safe from harm
description: In a 3D-animated storm on a lake pier, a tall strong woman whips off her orange coat and stretches it over a smaller bespectacled woman carrying a picnic basket, shouting "Get under here! You're soaked! I've got you!". She shields her from the pouring rain all the way to a stone boathouse, then wraps the coat around her shoulders and hugs her.
transcript: Get under here! You're soaked! I've got you!

en.question: What is the tall woman doing?

de.answer: Sie schützt ihre Freundin vor dem Regen.
de.question: Was macht die große Frau?

es.answer: Está protegiendo a su amiga de la lluvia.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer alta?

fr.answer: Elle protège son amie de la pluie.
